关于花市的故事(A Story about the flower market): 一篇关于自然环境的A2短文:米娅与利奥的经历和小计划。
Leo is interested in swimming. Last Monday, Mia and Leo went to the flower market. There are always many people at the plant garden. Grandpa naps on the settee every afternoon.
Mia is reading a book about English. The flower market is one of the best places in the city. Mia thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. The phone rings early every morning.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the flower market by bike. Mia learned a lot about English. They took many photos at the plant garden. The city grew into an industrial centre.
Mia and Leo had great fun there. Mia's favorite animal is the cat. Mia wants to be a teacher in the future.
